concepts.gloss_en: the supernal Will was revealed (revelation of the divine/supernal Ratzon)
the Will was revealed (revelation of the Ratzon, unmodified)

members.note: lacks the modifier העליון; the qualifier could narrow the referent (supernal Will vs. will in general), so kept separate per under-merge rule despite same Torah

notes: Both appear once in lm2:4 with identical proof snippets. The two forms may well denote the same revelation event, but 'העליון' is a distinguishing modifier that can narrow the referent; under-merge-beats-over-merge dictates keeping them separate. A human familiar with the passage could confirm they are the same event and merge.
